verdict.rationale: Insomnia's own Inso CLI can run collection tests headlessly and non-interactively in CI, with prompts disabled and exit codes returned, so automations can run unattended. The product has no documented built-in scheduler, monitor, or background agent. Recurring or triggered execution depends on the host CI or Git workflow, which earns no credit, and in-app collection runs are user-initiated one-off actions. Missing for 10: native recurring scheduling or monitors, background or agentic automation inside the product, independent corroboration of unattended runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Inso CLI is designed to run in a Continuous Integration (CI) environment. It disables prompts and provides exit codes to pass or fail the CI workflow.
Use the Insomnia CLI to automate the execution of your API tests using your existing Git workflows.
Automatically test multiple requests in your collections, with unlimited collection runs.
